blogs.title: Sleep Apnea Warning Signs You Should Not Ignore
blogs.summary: A practical guide to common symptoms, risk factors, and when to seek professional help.
blogs.content:
## Sleep Apnea Warning Signs

Sleep apnea can cause repeated breathing pauses during sleep. Common signs include loud snoring, gasping, morning headaches, dry mouth, and daytime sleepiness.

### When to Talk to a Doctor

If snoring is paired with choking, pauses in breathing, or persistent fatigue, it is worth discussing with a clinician. SnoreClinics AI can help you track patterns, but it is not a medical diagnosis.
